story.title: Ronaldo and Ramos
story.body: Real Madrid’s official profile lists Cristiano Ronaldo at 438 competitive appearances during his Madrid tenure from 2009 to 2018. Sergio Ramos’s official profile records 671 Real Madrid appearances across his 2005–2021 spell. These are whole-career totals for two different Madrid eras, not season counts.

story.title: Casillas and the comparison
story.body: Iker Casillas made 725 official matches for Real Madrid during his 1999–2015 tenure. The three totals therefore order from lowest to highest as Ronaldo (438), Ramos (671), and Casillas (725). Each figure belongs to that player’s complete Madrid career; the ordering compares totals, not seasons played or quality across eras.
